summary: Tested night-only prospecting window + outreach auto-send/CC. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_night_window_autosend.py (27 tests: unit with monkeypatched datetime/providers + an isolated throw-away Mongo DB for outreach logic + live API). 25/27 pass. Confirmed working: night_seconds_left (09:00-21:59 -> 0, 22:00 -> 11h, 01:00 -> 8h, 08:59 -> 60s), run_worker cron/watchdog skip 'daytime' (incl. <60s left), max_seconds capped to time left, manual trigger not restricted; watchdog endpoint spawns only when enabled AND in window (401 without secret); overview.night_window bool; crons.yml schedules correct; _migrate_v2 one-time (doesn't overwrite later edits); auto_approve (step1 approved+scheduled_at now, steps 2/3 approved w/o scheduled_at, LinkedIn stays pending, prospect -> approved); min_score 0 includes prospects without fit_score; PUT settings accepts auto_send/cc (trims), rejects bad cc 400; CC plumbing in mailer, Graph ccRecipients, SMTP Cc header, Gmail cc header; _send_one passes st['cc'] and schedules next step. UI: outreach-cc, outreach-auto-send, outreach-mode-text ('Emails send automatically (max 100/day, CC vineet.narang@fundle.ai)'), invalid-CC error toast, Prospecting pill shows 'Sleeping — runs nightly 10 PM–9 AM IST' (verified by intercepting overview with night_window=false), 'Paused' with real disabled state. 2 real bugs found (daily cap bypass = CRITICAL, mixed-contacts candidate filter).

critical.issue: Daily cap bypass: .limit(max(0, daily_cap - sent_today)) -> when the cap is reached the limit is 0, and Mongo limit(0) means NO LIMIT, so every run sends ALL due emails (up to to_list(500)). Reproduced: cap=2, 2 already sent today, 3 due -> 3 more sent. With auto-send + 455 pending drafts this would blast hundreds/day once a mailbox is connected. Fix: n = daily_cap - sent_today; if n <= 0 skip sending; else .limit(n).

No run lock / atomic claim: cron every 15 min + 'Run now' can overlap (a run drafting 30 sequences via LLM can exceed 15 min). Both runs read the same approved/due docs and send them twice, and the same prospect can be drafted twice (outreach_seq set only after drafting). Fix: lock like prospect_lock, or claim each message with find_one_and_update status approved->sending before sending.

minor.issue: {'contacts.email': {'$nin': [None, '']}} excludes a prospect if ANY contact lacks an email (array semantics). Live DB: 125 match vs 126 with $elemMatch. Use {'contacts': {'$elemMatch': {'email': {'$nin': [None, '']}}}}.
If step 1 send fails it becomes 'failed' and is never retried automatically; its approved steps 2/3 stay approved forever with no scheduled_at.
creds.refresh() and service...execute() are sync blocking calls inside async code (blocks event loop during sends). Pre-existing.

issues: With auto-send on, the default tab is still 'Needs approval · 455' — confusing; consider defaulting to Approved/scheduled or renaming when auto_send is true

rca of the issue: Daily cap: PyMongo/Motor treat cursor.limit(0) as 'no limit'; max(0, cap - sent) yields 0 exactly when the cap is reached. Repro: isolated DB, daily_cap=2, 2 docs sent today, 3 approved step-1 docs due, mailer.is_connected patched True -> run_outreach sends 3. Mitigation: guard n<=0 before querying.
